requirement_text.REQ-378: See handoffs/WF03-ISS0736-20260921/step-00-git-setup.json context.requirement_text.REQ-378 for the full verbatim text. Acceptance criteria: (1) a tenant_admin action revoking a signed-in business_user's access takes effect on that user's very next request with no sign-out/reload/token-expiry wait, demonstrated by a revoke-then-immediately-retry test with no sleep/token refresh; (2) the revoking action is reachable through Letflow's own web/ GUI, not only Keycloak; (3) the resulting 403 renders through the existing QueryStateBoundary/PermissionDenied contract unchanged, no new renderer state, no leaked content; (4) SECURITY-REVIEWER signs off explicitly on the chosen enforcement mechanism before merge.

task.description: Read handoffs/WF03-ISS0736-20260921/step-01-issue-fixer-diagnosis.json's result.summary in full -- it is ISSUE-FIXER's independently-verified root-cause diagnosis, including a fix-shape recommendation and an important scope note: the defect is not role-only, Letflow.Identity.User's `status` field (REQ-073 deactivation) is ALSO never read in the OIDC auth path, same defect shape. Design the fix per that diagnosis's precedent (Letflow.Identity.verify_api_token/2's live, uncached Repo.get_by/3-per-request pattern). Produce a design artefact under lib/letflow/design/ covering: (a) the exact new live-check step in AuthPipeline.authenticate_oidc/2 (where it goes in the pipeline, what it queries, what it does on revoked/inactive -- 401 or 403, and why), (b) whether/how this reuses or extends RoleRegistry/Identity.User, (c) the GUI action path for AC2 -- confirm whether UsersPage.tsx/GroupsPage.tsx's existing role/status-change actions already call an endpoint that can become the enforcing write path, or whether a new/changed endpoint is needed, (d) confirm AC3 is satisfied automatically (no renderer change needed) since this only changes what status code the backend returns, not renderer logic, (e) performance/scope note: this adds one query per authenticated OIDC request -- state explicitly whether that is acceptable as-is (mirroring the API-token branch's own unchallenged precedent) or needs a note for REVIEWER, (f) exact @spec-shaped function signatures and schema/migration shape if any new column/table is needed (e.g. does Letflow.Identity.User need a roles column, or does RoleRegistry already hold per-user role state that just needs reading?). Signatures and type/shape only -- no implementation function bodies (design docs never carry .ex code bodies beyond @spec-style signatures, per WF-02 Step 1b's own check). Do NOT implement.
acceptance_criteria: Every one of REQ-378's 4 acceptance criteria maps to a concrete design element, stated explicitly
The revocation check's exact query/lookup and denial behavior (status code, short-circuit point in the pipeline) is unambiguous enough to build from with no invented details
GUI reachability path (AC2) is traced to a specific existing or new endpoint/action in web/src/pages/admin/UsersPage.tsx or GroupsPage.tsx
No .ex/.tsx implementation code bodies in the design doc -- signatures/types/schema shapes only

Design explicitly states whether gap 3 from REQ-378's description (client-side session.roles staleness after silent token refresh) is in or out of scope for this fix (REQ-378 says it covers gap 2 only; confirm this design does not silently also fix or ignore gap 3 without saying so)
